// The comment mentions CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, which is allowed.

/** Reads plugin variables from the environment, which is forbidden. */
export function pluginRoot(): string {
  const fromIndex = process.env['CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT'];
  const fromProperty = process.env.CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA;
  const fromTemplate = `${fromIndex ?? ''}CLAUDE_PLUGIN_${fromProperty ?? ''}`;
  return fromTemplate;
}
